tool.name: find_wallet_activity
tool.description:
Find transaction references involving a wallet in the selected LOCAL dataset, optionally filtered by a UTC period. Saved records are replay, not a fresh chain query. Results always have partial wallet-history coverage. No match does not prove inactivity. This tool does not infer ownership or direct counterparties.
